xmldoc.short_description: Estimate a 2-D image registration transform by phase correlation.

param_input_item.param_description: Fixed grayscale or RGB image with the same size as moving.
Transformation type name. Supported values are translation, rigid, similarity and affine. This first implementation estimates the translation component.

param_output_item.param_description: Affine 2-D transformation structure that maps moving toward fixed.
Peak value of the normalized phase-correlation surface.

description.p: imregcorr estimates the integer-pixel translation between two same-size images using normalized phase correlation. RGB inputs are converted to grayscale before registration. The result is returned as an affine2d transformation.
